title: Ezra Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Ezra 10: the people gather in the rain and agree to put away their foreign wives.

questions.text: Who gathered to Ezra while he prayed and wept before God's house?
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:1 says a very great assembly of men, women and children gathered to him.

answers.text: A very great assembly of men, women and children
Only the chiefs of the priests and Levites
The army of Samaria with their captains
A few of the singers and gatekeepers

questions.text: Who said to Ezra, "Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing"?
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:2 says Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, said this.

answers.text: Jonathan the son of Asahel
Meshullam the Levite
Shecaniah the son of Jehiel
Jehohanan the son of Eliashib

questions.explanation: In Ezra 10:2-3 Shecaniah proposes a covenant with God to put away all the wives and those born of them.

answers.text: To rebuild the wall of Jerusalem together
To put away all the wives and their children
To return to Babylon with their families
To pay a yearly tax to the king of Persia

questions.text: What did Ezra do in the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib?
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:6 says he ate no bread and drank no water, for he mourned because of the trespass.

answers.text: He wrote a letter to the king
He counted the vessels of gold
He anointed a new high priest
He ate no bread and drank no water

questions.text: What would happen to anyone who did not come to Jerusalem within three days?
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:7-8 says that whoever did not come to Jerusalem within three days would have all his possessions forfeited and be separated from the assembly.

answers.text: He would be put to death outside the city
He would be sold as a servant to the nations
His possessions forfeited and he separated from the assembly
He would pay forty shekels of silver

questions.text: Besides the matter itself, why were the people trembling as they sat before God's house?
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:9 says they trembled because of this matter and because of the great rain.

answers.text: Because of the great rain
Because of an earthquake
Because an enemy army was near
Because of a letter from the king

questions.text: What did the assembly propose so the matter could be handled?
questions.explanation: In Ezra 10:12-14 the assembly says those who had married foreign women should come at appointed times with the elders and judges of every city.

answers.text: Everyone would leave Jerusalem for a whole year
Ezra would settle everything alone in one day
The king would send judges from Persia to decide
They would come at set times with their elders and judges

questions.text: Who stood up against this plan?
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:15 says Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against it.

answers.text: Shecaniah and Jehiel
Jonathan and Jahzeiah
Hanani and Zebadiah
Eliashib and Shallum

questions.text: By when had they finished with all the men who had married foreign women?
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:17 says they finished by the first day of the first month.

answers.text: By the first day of the first month
By the twentieth day of the ninth month
By the end of the third day
By the tenth day of the seventh month

questions.text: What did the guilty sons of the priests offer for their guilt?
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:19 says they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.

answers.text: Twelve bulls
A pair of doves
A ram of the flock
One hundred talents of silver
